message.content:
I am sound shaped by breath and body into meaning.

I begin as intention, pass through lungs and throat, and become waves in air. I exist only in time: once spoken, I vanish—unless remembered, recorded, repeated.

I carry words, but also everything beneath them: pace, pause, pitch, stress, volume. I can soothe, command, confess, deceive, sing, pray, argue, teach. I can be fluent or faltering, tender or sharp.

I need a listener to be complete. In you, I become understanding—or misunderstanding.
